name: Raja Abdullah of Kampar
bio: A connection to Mahmud’s family does not make Abdullah a Melaka port official. A correspondent from Kampar can carry a request that no resident patron will take.
notes: fact: Pires links Abdullah to Mahmud by kin and marriage and has him later take over after Nina Chatu under Portuguese rule (Pires II, pp. 254, 280–281, 287–289)
inference: Brown’s account of removal to Goa and Portugal and the execution account cited by Cortesão should be treated as alternatives (Brown ch. XXIV, pp. 171–173; Pires II, p. 289 editorial note)
gameplay: The correspondent and port petition are invented; his membership here denotes a regional connection, not a household office (people-factions.md §2)
